name: sign-timer-words
title: Sign: timer (words)
description: A sign for "timer", drawn as words along its strokes.

files.content:
"use client"

import * as React from "react"
import { Sign, type SignProps } from "@/components/ui/sign"
import type { SignShape } from "@/lib/0db/sign-shapes"

const shape: SignShape = {
  "word": "timer",
  "line": [
    [
      [
        "M",
        10,
        2
      ],
      [
        "L",
        14,
        2
      ]
    ],
    [
      [
        "M",
        12,
        14
      ],
      [
        "L",
        15,
        11
      ]
    ],
    [
      [
        "O",
        12,
        14,
        8,
        0,
        360
      ]
    ]
  ]
}

function SignTimerWords(props: Omit<SignProps, "shape" | "variant">) {
  return <Sign shape={shape} variant="words" {...props} />
}

export { SignTimerWords, shape }
